title: Pushes to main rebuild every image, not just the changed ones
description:
Each image in this repository has its own push-triggered workflow (`wgcw.yml`, `waml.yml`, `session-complete.yml`, `positron-sagemaker.yml`), and every one of them rebuilds unconditionally on any push to `main`. A change confined to `positron-sagemaker/` still spends runner time rebuilding WGCW, WAML, and Session Complete — the last of which is the largest build in the repo and runs on `ubuntu-latest-8x`.

The product image repositories don't have this problem. They call `posit-dev/images-shared/.github/workflows/bakery-build-native.yml`, which passes `--base-ref ${{ github.event.before }}` to `bakery ci matrix`. Bakery maps the push's changed files onto the image/version matrix and returns an empty matrix when nothing relevant was touched.

These workflows hand-roll their matrix job rather than calling the shared workflow — WGCW needs GCP workload identity federation, and Positron SageMaker needs the SOCI merge job — so they need the same change-awareness applied inline.

Scheduled weekly rebuilds and manual dispatches should continue to build the full matrix.

title: Configure pull-through cache for positron-sagemaker on public ECR
description:
The admin guide for Positron on SageMaker now documents a pull-through cache as an alternative to the manual docker pull/tag/push setup in Step 1. Configuring a pull-through cache in the platform-team account would allow the private `positron-sagemaker` ECR repository to be populated automatically from `public.ecr.aws/posit/positron-sagemaker` on first pull, removing the need for the weekly mirror workflow in platform-infra.

## What this involves

- Create a pull-through cache rule mapping a prefix (e.g. `ecr-public`) to `public.ecr.aws` in the platform-team AWS account
- Add `ecr:BatchImportUpstreamImage` to the SageMaker execution role so Studio Spaces can trigger upstream fetches
- Evaluate whether this replaces or complements the existing scheduled mirror workflow in platform-infra
